compilation.basis: 1f_view.png: calibrated from overall dimension lines 15000mm (x) and 8000mm (y) whose extension-line arrow tips sit at outer wall faces px x=425/1815 and y=1087/346. Perimeter drawn at outer wall face (single representative line, no modeled thickness). Interior corridor walls (py=624 north-of-corridor, py=832 south-of-corridor) measured from the left dimension chain 3000/250/1500/250/3000mm. Room-dividing partitions at the two unlabeled small double-tick gaps in the top dimension chain, centered near x=888px (~4950-5060mm) and x=1350px (~9940-10030mm), consistent with three roughly-equal-width offices per row.
